nodes.name: Validate Payload
nodes.notes: Expects the FlowPilot webhook POST body (nested under the Webhook node's .body) shaped as: { request_id, plan_id, action_id, action: { tool: 'calendar', operation: 'create_event', parameters: { title, start_datetime, end_datetime, timezone } } }. Outputs { title, start_datetime, end_datetime, timezone } consumed by the Google Calendar node below.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, external_event_id: $json.id, html_link: $json.htmlLink, message: "Calendar event created successfully" } }}
={{ { success: false, error_code: "CALENDAR_API_ERROR", message: $json.error?.message || "Failed to create the Google Calendar event." } }}
={{ { success: false, error_code: "INVALID_PAYLOAD", message: $json.error?.message || "The request payload was invalid." } }}
